citationText: 4. Leonardo da Vinci's exploration of Alberti's work on perspective, in particular the euclidian notion of a visual pyramid at the apex of which stood an observer, led him to experiment with off-center observer positions. Anamorphic sketches by Leonardo have been found dating from c. 1485 (see Anamorphoses: Games of Perception and Illusion in Art , ed. Schuyt M. and Elffers J. , [ NY : Abrams , 1976 ]). Abbe's patent for an anamorphoser for still photography was filed in 1898 .
